comments.comment: LCC/LCMS are the only Lutheran churches in North America.
The LCMS is the one true church and a continuation of the church that Christ founded.
I’ve been going to an LCMS church for over a year now and it’s the best decision I’ve made
I’m glad people are seeing the folly of this movement, Dr. Jordan B. Cooper called it months ago
We are moving to the US and am going to have to consider whether we want to settle with a nearby ELCA church or take the drive to an LCMS one. This is definitely helping our considerations.
At this point just drop "Lutheran" from the name. Also "Evangelical". And "Church".
If your an orthodox Lutheran there is no reason to be in the ELCA, leave and come to the LCMS, the true mainline Lutheran Church

On another note, “Reconquista” the schismatic church that broke away from the mainline. That whole idea/movement really went from “let’s revitalize the historic churches that hold true to the confessions of our faith” to “yeah young people should attend a church with a Pastrix and secular ideology, cause the building is pretty and 100 years ago had proper teaching”.

Let these churches die out, as the majority already are. Faithful believers can hit them in the future and use them to glorify the Lord.
